about: functions/index.js scanBoard matches the hotfix Kunal deployed on 17 Nov 2026: gemini-3.8-flash, no sampling settings, a 50 second budget, and the reply read from every answer part with thought parts skipped. Gate 126 runs it in plain Node with firebase-functions and fetch stubbed (no network, no key); only its TC-R202f and TC-R202g lines are graded. One situation, because the gate drives no screen. NOT COVERED: whether Google's real 3.8 Flash reads a real board - that is his phone check of a scan after the deploy (Cloud Logging, Cloud Run service scanboard).
